name: manual_9c27e7
claim: MiniGraph converts a graph node's Interrupt into an interrupted PerpetuaState (status=interrupted, interrupt_node/interrupt_prompt/interrupt_payload metadata), it does NOT propagate to the ainvoke caller — assert on the returned state, and never record an interrupt as a failure outcome in ledgers because it is structural HITL control flow

decisions.notes: First outbound-ledger test wrongly expected pytest.raises(Interrupt); existing transport-contract tests and a rerun against real MiniGraph semantics showed the interrupted-state shape.

rationale: First outbound-ledger test wrongly expected pytest.raises(Interrupt); existing transport-contract tests and a rerun against real MiniGraph semantics showed the interrupted-state shape.
